name: Apple Card
description: Apple Card web account access. Sign in and discover the authenticated card account. Read-only balance support requires authenticated verification; no payment actions.

actions.label: Find signed-in Apple Card account
actions.description: Discover the authenticated Apple Card account from the live application store; confirmed signed-out pages return no sessions.

actions.label: Sign in to Apple Card
actions.description: Open Apple’s embedded Apple Account sign-in for manual authentication. No passwords are handled by this service.
